@CChang1124 So how many others? I have to give credit where it is due. I applaud #BlackLivesMatter 

I'm Asian, but I just accepted the whiteness of everything. It took that movement to make me see we can expect and demand more. In society we come in all skin colors, etc. Let's do better

Between the fact there has been acceleration of #ClimateCrisis and the high daily death count from #COVID19, the movie #DontLookUp isn't really satire anymore is it? How did we humans become so incredibly stupid and sheep-like?
